semantics.scores: every arm reuses the scores captured by the full authorized scan through the real engine; no provider requests
semantics.jev: meanJevInputTokens and totalJevCostUsd are the engine preflight estimates for the supplied files at the configured price
semantics.candidates: lexical: BM25 over prepared files; mentioned: paths named in the question resolved by suffix; supplied: the files holding the labelled evidence (E5)
semantics.agent: agent tokens = candidate list + JevGrep response + full rereads of supplied files whose evidence was missed; fullRead = reading every supplied file in full
semantics.coverage: a scoped search reports coverage of the supplied files only; missedByCandidates counts evidence in files never supplied
